summary: The 'default' page is the login and authentication entry point for the HSPnet web application. It implements user login, multi-factor authentication (MFA), recaptcha, locale/language switching, dynamic messages, feedback, downtime warnings, and new program notifications. The UI includes validation, popups, accessibility, and responsive design elements.
purpose: To securely authenticate users, provide locale-specific features, display dynamic system messages, and notify users of relevant system events (downtime, archive warnings, new programs). Ensures only valid, authorized users can access the application, supports MFA, and guides the user through login and authentication with robust error handling and UI feedback.

workflows.name: Login and Authentication
steps: RequiredFieldValidator ensures both fields are not empty.
On login click, Security.Login checks credentials and outputs ErrorMessage, LastTry, LockedOut, Inactivated, AuthCode, Captcha.
If credentials valid and AuthCode returned, show modal popup for entering 6-digit MFA code.
User enters 6-digit code; validated with Security.ValidateAuthCode.
On invalid code, error message shown and reset; on repeated failures, reload page or display feedback.
If Captcha required and enabled, redirect to Google ReCaptcha page.
If login succeeds, redirect to StartScreen or set cookies as needed.
If user is locked out/inactivated, hide password and forgot links.

workflows.name: User Interface Setup
steps: Language switcher and locale-dependent panels displayed (HeaderEN/HeaderFR).
Dynamic messages pulled from HelpRecord and updated on UI (Welcome, PleaseWait, Alert, News, Training, Resources, Feedback, Downtime).
New Programs notification grid is populated and shown or hidden based on data.
Archive warnings displayed with countdown and message.
Footer is dynamically created with copyright and version.

workflows.name: Error Handling and Feedback
steps: On login error, display message and show/hide relevant UI elements.
On last try before lockout, show larger forgot password link and enable login checkbox.
General error management for expired or invalid MFA codes with appropriate messages.

business_rules: UserSession.Locale determines page language and redirect targets.
UserSession.ProvinceFull and ProvinceCode used for screen titles and new program notifications.
Archive warnings shown if HelpRecord has warning and days remain.
Downtime warning shown only on Sunday between 8:00 and 8:30 PM.
If no new programs, hide the WelcomeNewPrograms section.
validations: RequiredFieldValidator for each MFA code textbox.
Login enable checkbox must be checked on last try before lockout.
6-digit numeric MFA code enforced in entry logic (UI and server-side).
calculations: Archive countdown days calculated and displayed.
Dynamic footer combines copyright, version, and version number.
HelpRecord days remaining for archive notification.
conditions: IsPostBack controls when UI is initialized/reset.
Locale switching controls which header panel and links are visible.
If user locked out/inactivated, hide password/forgot links.
If last login try, show enable login checkbox and expanded forgot password link.
Downtime warning only for specific time window.
system_behavior: Redirects user based on locale, login result, and system configuration.
Loads ReCaptcha if agency requires and enabled.
Displays dynamic messages from HelpRecord database.
Handles popup modal for MFA entry.
Auto-focuses input fields based on session state.
Provides responsive, accessible UI with script-managed behaviors.
Removes global CSS if jQuery available to avoid conflicts.
exceptions: Invalid login or MFA code shows error and may reload.
Unknown errors in MFA process handled with generic error message.
No new programs hides notification grid.
Locked out/inactivated users have reduced login UI options.
